item.title: llm-openrouter 0.7
item.summary: Release: llm-openrouter 0.7 Now that this plugin is compatible with LLM 0.32 it works much better with reasoning LLMs available through OpenRouter. Updated for compatibility with LLM 0.32 . Models now use OpenRouter's implementation of the Responses API . Three new server-side tools: Shell , WebFetch , and WebSearch . Enable these with options like -T WebSearch . Tags: llm , openrouter
